overrideNotes.playwright-core: ARCH-05 reproducible build. @axe-core/playwright depends on its own playwright-core range, which resolves to a second copy and a second, incompatible set of Page types. Pinned to one version.
overrideNotes.security: The remaining entries force patched versions of transitive dependencies that a direct dependency still pins to a vulnerable range. `08` SEC-11 requires `npm audit --audit-level=high` to report zero findings, and that gate blocks merge. Each entry should be removed once the parent ships the fix on its own.
